daily.today_energy: Your emotional intuition is hitting different today. Trust those gut feelings—they're basically your spiritual GPS. Channel that cozy Cancer energy into something that makes you feel safe and seen.
daily.love: Whether you're coupled up or solo, vulnerability is your superpower rn. Let someone in, or be that person for yourself. Real connection happens when the walls come down, and you're ready for that energy shift.
daily.career: Your creative problem-solving is off the charts today. Don't doubt your ideas—that instinct you have about the project direction? Go with it. Your ability to read the room is literally your competitive advantage.
daily.health: Your body's asking for grounding activities. Maybe that's a long walk, some journaling, or just sitting with your feelings. Listen to what brings you peace—rest isn't lazy, it's strategic energy management.

weekly.overview: This week's energy invites you to trust your intuition, Cancer. A shift in your emotional landscape brings clarity around what truly matters. Expect meaningful conversations and subtle cosmic nudges toward alignment with your authentic self.
weekly.love: Venus is softly highlighting your connection zone. Whether single or coupled, vulnerability is your superpower right now. Let yourself feel deeply without overthinking—genuine moments of presence will spark the most authentic connections.
weekly.career: Mercury's influence suggests this is prime time for pitching ideas or having that conversation you've been sitting on. Your natural insight into people's needs is amplified. Trust your gut on projects and don't dim your light waiting for perfect conditions.
weekly.health: Your nervous system is asking for gentle attention this week. Lean into calming rituals that feel nourishing—whether that's longer walks, meditation, or time near water. Listen to what your body needs rather than pushing through; rest is productive.
